basis: Audited fiscal-year endowment amounts reported by each institution; accounting scope and presentation differ by school.
explanation: Both values are from audited statements for June 30, 2025, but the statements use different scopes. DePauw reports total endowment net assets including pledges receivable and perpetual trusts; Wabash reports pooled endowment net assets only. Neither is cash available for general spending.

enrollment.source_label: U.S. Department of Education, College Navigator (IPEDS): DePauw University

comparable.source_note: Note 12, printed pp. 20–21 (PDF pp. 22–23), reports these two components inside DePauw's total; they are taken out so DePauw is on the same pooled basis as Wabash

depauw.source_note: Note 12, printed pp. 20–21 (PDF pp. 22–23): total endowment net assets at June 30, 2025, including $38,817,699 of pledges receivable and $13,010,125 of perpetual trusts

enrollment.source_label: U.S. Department of Education, College Navigator (IPEDS): Wabash College

comparable.source_note: Checked 2026-11-13: Note 11 reports pooled endowment net assets only (donor-restricted and board-designated funds), and Wabash's audited statements give no endowment total that includes pledges or perpetual trusts (its contributions receivable are Note 3 and its perpetual trust interests, $11,259,766, Note 5, separate balance-sheet items), so no adjustment is made

wabash.source_note: Note 11, printed pp. 23–24 (PDF pp. 25–26): pooled endowment net assets at June 30, 2025
